conventions.press_state_encoding: press_channel_state carries the armed per-channel impulse magnitude: armed = press_channel_jn_ns_per_tick (0.3 N*s), released = 0.0 N*s EXACTLY; no third state exists (contract valid_input_ranges: a record outside {armed, released} is a structural fault, not a value)
conventions.impulse_units: jn/jt are per-tick impulses in N*s at press_dt_s 0.005 s; operating force is the DECLARED /dt conversion (0.3/0.005 = 60 N); no cross-tick memory (contract timing.per_tick_semantics)
conventions.slot_f32_mapping: the contract unit slot_f32 (dimensionless float32 delivered observation slots) has no dimension in the pinned spec grammar's canonical-unit table (spec_unit_unknown, verified 2026-10-02); it is declared 'unitless' in this document under this mapping note. The contract's unit rows stay verbatim in the task result (Lieutenant ruling 2)
conventions.one_exchange_quantity: this grammar types ONE exchange quantity per connection: jn (the contract's primary transferred quantity, protocol normal_press_impulse). jt is the connection's second READ-ONLY seam record (single writer: the ground side); it is carried in the implementation's window view and delivered controller-side through the declared 32-slot table (ch*_jt_Ns), never mis-typed as a second exchange or an invented second connection
conventions.ground_section_scope: membrane.ground.v1 appears ONLY as the frozen contract-side external reference (the owned/published seam records jn/jt of the pinned port contract) so the connection consumes PUBLISHED states per the grammar. It is NOT an authored interior: the interior law forbids reading or declaring the neighbor's interior
conventions.observation_delivery: the 32-slot float32 table is delivered through the pinned MAT2-G05 seam implementation and its named delivery gates (undeclared_field, timing_unbound, timing_drift, named_absent_occupied, privileged_source, nonfinite_value, dim_mismatch); the x_* namespace and the six-name privileged registry stay refused
